regions.name: Ontario South
regions.description: Southern and central Ontario up to 46.8° N: Windsor to Ottawa, cottage country, Algonquin, Sudbury and North Bay.

regions.name: Ontario North
regions.description: Northern Ontario from 45.5° N: Algonquin's north side, North Bay, Sudbury, Sault Ste. Marie, Thunder Bay, Kenora and the far north.
